label: OpenArt Image Generation
description: Generate or edit a still image through OpenArt's live MCP catalog without freezing a model or tool schema into the BONE.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Exact image prompt sent through the selected live OpenArt generation tool.

model.label: Model ID
model.description: Optional live OpenArt model id. Leave empty to use the worker's current advertised default.

endpoint_id.label: OpenArt Tool ID
endpoint_id.description: Optional exact live OpenArt generation tool name. Leave empty to let the worker select a compatible image tool.

parameters.label: Live Tool Parameters (JSON)
parameters.description: Optional provider arguments validated against the selected tool's live schema. Do not duplicate prompt, model, or endpoint_id here.

reference_image.label: Reference Image
reference_image.description: Optional local path, workspace-relative path, HTTPS URL, or provider reference understood by the selected live image/edit tool.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Preserve an already-authored frame prompt exactly. OpenArt's MCP catalog is live and may change, so never invent or freeze model ids, tool names, or parameter options in this BONE. Set model or endpoint_id only when the user selected it or live/provider data supplied it. Put only live-schema-supported extras in parameters; references belong in reference_image.
do: Leave model and endpoint_id empty when no explicit compatible selection exists
Preserve reference_image for image edits or reference-guided generation
Let the native queue worker validate parameters against the selected live tool schema
dont: Copy Higgsfield or another provider's model and parameter fields into this BONE
Guess a current OpenArt model or tool name
Place prompt, model, endpoint_id, credentials, or signed URLs inside parameters

x-genlock-surface.tagline: Generate or edit a still image through OpenArt's live MCP catalog without freezing a model or tool schema into the BONE.
